name: devflow
description: A maintainer-led workflow for Claude Code: locate, design, implement, review and commit through fresh agents with pinned models; a behaviour map of every surface; plans with claimable steps; a project manager; releases through a tested candidate; and hooks that turn the process rules into checks.

session_start_output.title: Session start output
session_start_output.description: full (everything), short (branch, CI, next step, problems only) or off (only the devflow base line). Applies in every project.

maintainer_name.title: Your name as maintainer
maintainer_name.description: Your name for /devflow:setup to suggest in a project's profile and devflow.json.

maintainer_timezone.title: Your time zone
maintainer_timezone.description: For example UTC+7 or Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh, for /devflow:setup to suggest.

default_models.title: Your default models
default_models.description: Your own model per role, for projects whose board leaves the role on default. Write role: Model, effort; role: Model, for example implementer: sonnet, low; tester: haiku. Valid roles are the board's keys. The floors still hold.
